title: Design System: CSF Compliance — QID v3

display.purpose: High-emphasis organization, project, and authentication headings.

headline.purpose: Section headings and major workspace titles.

body.purpose: Long compliance reading and form content.

label.purpose: Field labels, metadata, outcome codes, and context markers.

shadows.name: ambient-panel
shadows.purpose: Quiet lift for organization forms, deletion confirmation, and authentication panels.

shadows.name: primary-action
shadows.purpose: Soft separation for branded primary actions.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Button, border, field, and navigation state transitions.

motion.name: assessment-reveal
motion.purpose: Expanded assessment content entering the reading flow.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one clear action in a form or workflow section.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 42px; padding: 10px 16px; color: #fff; background: var(--accent-grad); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font: 750 0.88rem/1.2 var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s ease; box-shadow: 0 14px 28px -18px var(--accent-glow); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--magenta-soft), var(--purple)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-outline); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet navigation or supporting action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 42px; padding: 10px 16px; color: var(--accent-dark); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font: 750 0.88rem/1.2 var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--accent-faint); border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-outline); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Danger Text Action
components.description: A deliberately secondary destructive action with a confirmation step behind it.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 8px; color: var(--error); background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; font: 750 0.82rem/1.2 var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--error-soft); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-outline); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A readable white field with an explicit label above it.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; min-width: 0; gap: 7px; } .ds-field > span { color: var(--muted-strong); font: 750 0.78rem/1.3 var(--font-sans); } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 11px 12px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font: 400 15px/1.65 var(--font-sans); transition: border-color 0.16s ease, box-shadow 0.16s ease, background 0.16s ease; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--input-hover); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus); outline: 0; }

components.name: Function Navigation
components.description: A labeled index that keeps the reader oriented within the CSF Functions.
components.css: .ds-sidebar { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; padding: 28px 14px 20px; background: var(--surface); border-right: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-nav-item { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; color: var(--muted); text-align: left; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font: 400 15px/1.65 var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item-active { color: var(--accent-dark); background: var(--accent-soft); border-color: var(--accent-line); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-outline); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A compact text-labeled state for project, response, role, and coverage context.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; align-items: center; padding: 5px 9px; color: var(--accent-dark); background: var(--accent-soft); border-radius: 999px; font: 800 0.68rem/1.2 var(--font-sans); letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Project Context Metadata
components.description: A top-aligned project facts grid that keeps long scope copy and short dates visually anchored together.
components.html:
Assessment period
Q3 2026
Scope boundary
Production web application and API
components.css: .ds-project-metadata { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin: 0; padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-project-metadata > div { display: grid; align-content: start; align-items: start; min-width: 0; gap: 3px; } .ds-project-metadata dt { color: var(--muted); font: 750 0.68rem/1.3 var(--font-sans); } .ds-project-metadata dd { margin: 0; color: var(--ink); font: 400 0.82rem/1.65 var(--font-sans); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

components.name: Assessment Card
components.description: An expandable outcome row that keeps code, title, coverage route, and detail body together.
components.css: .ds-assessment-card { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-md); } .ds-assessment-summary { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 112px minmax(0, 1fr) auto 32px; align-items: center; width: 100%; min-height: 76px; gap: 18px; padding: 16px 18px; color: var(--ink); text-align: left; background: var(--surface); border: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-assessment-summary:hover { background: var(--surface-subtle); } .ds-assessment-summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-outline); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-outcome-code { color: var(--accent-text); font: 850 0.8rem/1.3 var(--font-mono); } .ds-expand-mark { display: grid; width: 30px; height: 30px; place-items: center; color: var(--accent); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 50%; }

components.name: Response & Evidence Panel
components.description: A single surface for stakeholder response, evidence, review actions, and labeled status.
components.html:
Stakeholder response

Response and evidence for this outcome.
components.css: .ds-response-panel { display: grid; gap: 16px; padding: 22px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-response-panel textarea { min-height: 90px; padding: 11px 12px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); resize: vertical; } .ds-response-panel textarea:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus); outline: 0; }

narrative.overview:
The interface turns a complex assessment into a clear, accountable workspace. Dark graphite surfaces are the default reading environment; a light QID surface set remains available for bright environments. Magenta-to-purple brand cues mark the active Function, the next action, and the few statuses that need attention. The result follows the Versotis QID v3 token reference without sacrificing long compliance-reading sessions.

The system keeps Counselor interpretation, Stakeholder response/evidence input, and Reviewer feedback visually legible as different kinds of work. Organization and project pages use structured lists and compact forms; assessment pages use an editorial reading column with expandable outcome cards. The visual language uses the brand gradient only for actions and orientation, avoiding decorative chrome and heavy shadows that compete with compliance text. Existing component class contracts remain in place so the redesign does not alter API, role, or workflow behavior.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first work surfaces use #0b0914, #13101f, and #1c182d; light mode uses #faf9fd and white reading surfaces.
Magenta-to-purple used as orientation and action, not as decoration.
Space Grotesk for headings, Inter for long-form body copy, and JetBrains Mono for wayfinding/data labels.
A 12-column desktop grid with a 1200px content frame, a 260px workspace rail, and explicit Current / Target comparison.
Thin borders, 6–16px corners, and restrained QID elevation for raised panels.
Role-aware surfaces that distinguish reading, reviewing, and completing input.
Project context metadata aligned from a shared top edge so uneven copy lengths do not make short values appear vertically suspended.

rules.name: The Brand Cue Rule
rules.body: Magenta and purple should explain where the reader is or what action is available; the brand gradient belongs to actions and orientation, not whole reading sections.

rules.name: The Labeled State Rule
rules.body: Current, target, Reviewing, Approved, error, and permission states use color alongside a visible text label.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Let hierarchy and a readable line length do the organizing; do not compensate for long compliance text with oversized decorative type.

rules.name: The Flat Workpaper Rule
rules.body: If a border and surface change can establish hierarchy, do not add a shadow.

dos: Do keep compliance copy on a high-contrast QID surface with a readable measure.
Do use the QID canvas and thin rules to group content before reaching for shadow.
Do reserve magenta/purple for active location, primary action, focus, and meaningful status.
Do distinguish Counselor interpretation from Stakeholder response/evidence input through layout and labels.
Do make Current and Target profiles visually distinct and textually labeled.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, role/status text, and responsive reading order at every breakpoint.
donts: Don't use the brand gradient outside primary actions or purposeful orientation cues; avoid glass effects, decorative illustrations, and dense dashboard chrome.
Don't use color alone to communicate response, coverage, or permission state.
Don't turn every list row into a raised card; use borders and tonal layers first.
Don't use JetBrains Mono as a display face; reserve it for codes, labels, and measurement.
Don't make Stakeholder input controls look like Counselor-owned profile editing controls.
Don't stretch assessment copy across the full viewport when a readable measure is available.

qidV3Implementation.theme: dark-first with explicit data-theme light override
